text:
Viktorija Einorė-Bechor 

Thank you so much for sharing your experience .you’re really impressive. I actually have one day a week where I try to speak Hebrew with my partner all day, but it often falls apart because I get confused myself 😂  
Still, I can see how speaking every day would be a really good method. Thank you so much for the advice 🙏
